2025-06-06T15:44:56.025981+00:00 sicharge-cp [local0:err] sicharge-cp-backend/27a444658f26[696]: Error on LEM DC Meter (meter id: 1222660515 status: {"value":16,"bits":{"
suLinkStatusIsOk":false
,"muFatalErrorOccured":false,"transactionIsOnGoing":false,"tamperingIsDetected":false,"timeSyncStatusIsOk":true,"overTemperatureIsDetected":false,"reversedVoltage":false,"suMeasureFailureOccurred":false}}, error: {"value":0,"bits":{"muInitIsFailed":false,"suStateIsInvalid":false,"versionCheckIsFailed":false,"muRngInitIsFailed":false,"muDataIntegrityIsFailed":false,"muFwIntegrityIsFailed":false,"suIntegrityIsFailed":false,"logbookIntegrityIsFailed":false,"logbookIsFull":false,"memoryAccessIsFailed":false,"muStateIsFailed":false}})
This status flag in the DCBM system indicating a communication issue between the Meter Unit and the Sensor Unit:
"suLinkStatusIsOk": false
This status means that the Meter Unit is currently unable to establish a proper link with the Sensor Unit.
To resolve this, an
onsite inspection
is necessary to verify the following:
Proper connection of the data link cable on both the Meter Unit and Sensor Unit
Integrity and correct pairing of the Meter and Sensor Units
Physical condition of the cable and connectors
Presence of any tampering or environmental/environmental damage (e.g., corrosion, moisture)
